name: op-secrets
description: 1Password for Claude Code. op-store saves a secret through a native dialog outside the chat and writes it to 1Password, never via argv or env. op-env injects your op:// references into Claude, its hooks and MCP servers. Five hooks erase pasted secrets and block op read, printenv and .env reads. macOS/Windows/Linux.
